coaching.headline: We won majors 22-19 and every fight we took, 4-0, but still lost on towers 4-9.
coaching.team: We won the duo lane clean — first blood at 2.7, first Fangtooth, zero duo deaths before 10 to their three — and two of five role matchups (Murdock, Shinbi) read favorably for us at some point. The 18-minute teamfight, traded 2-2 with Murdock and Khaimera already dead, cost our first tower at 18.8. We answered by winning the 22.5-minute fight 2-0 and taking Fangtooth, but they took an Outer Tower in the same window. The game turned in the 27-to-35-minute stretch. Shinbi's solo catch at 27.4 cost an Inner Tower, Morigesh's catch at 31.7 cost four structures in a minute, and Khaimera's three late solo catches fed the Primal Fangtooth, an Inhibitor, and the Core. We still won the last fight, at 35.7, 2-1, but the Core had already fallen. Majors finished 22-19 ours, fights 4-0 ours, towers 4-9 theirs.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Five solo catches from 27 to 35 minutes — Shinbi once, Morigesh once, Khaimera three times — each fed a structure or major while the team kept winning the fights around them; that pattern, not any single fight, turned the 22-19 major lead into the loss.

deepDive.ledger: Their first tower fell at 18.8 after the 18-minute teamfight, which we traded 2-2 with Murdock and Khaimera already dead. We then won the 22.5-minute fight 2-0 and took Fangtooth, but they took an Outer Tower in the same window — the win never bought map control. Shinbi's solo catch at 27.4 cost the Inner Tower at 27.9, and their Genesis Core fell in the same window, with only Shinbi dead. Morigesh's solo catch at 31.7 cost four structures in a minute: the Outer Tower (31.8), Inner Tower (32.1), and both Inhibitors (32.3, 32.6), the last two with Khaimera also dead. The 33-minute teamfight, opened a body down after Khaimera's death 37 seconds earlier, cost another Inner Tower at 33.5 as Murdock and Narbash also fell. Khaimera's last solo catch at 34.6 doomed the Core, which fell at 36.1 even though the final fight, at 35.7, was won 2-1.
deepDive.theCall: At 31.7, with us already down two Outer Towers and an Inner Tower, Morigesh needed to group instead of roaming alone — that one catch by The Fey fed four structures (31.8-32.6) in under a minute, turning a close structure count into the decisive stretch that ended 4-9.
deepDive.rule: After losing a tower or ally, group before the next objective — don't roam solo down a structure.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 36 minutes, fewer deaths than about 91% of The Fey mid players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Fly Trap at rank 3: 95s base, about 74.2s by the end (22% shorter) from 28 ability haste: Megacosm 10, Tainted Scepter 10, Soulbearer 8.
7 takedowns (3 kills, 4 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice), Nature's Vengeance (passive).
Overseer (Exalted): Enhance your Ultimate Ability: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
The Fey dealt 36,135 hero damage, 31% of their team's, with +520 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11, Overseer 8; against Murdock (level 18: about 48 magical armor, 29 after penetration; took 7,481 magical damage from heroes, 48% of all hero damage they took) and Morigesh (level 18: about 49 magical armor, 30 after penetration; took 18,706 magical damage from heroes, 67% of all hero damage they took) that is about 15% and 15% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
